generation_review.prompt: Draw exactly ONE original Small Seal glyph from the attached four-specimen reference. Inspect all available THX CCZ QJZ DYC specimens; choose coherent whole THX construction, no blending variants. Rounded Gothic sans-serif MONOLINE, absolutely constant stroke width about 3% canvas, round caps and joins, smooth curves, no taper or brush or serif. Faithful connections, separate strokes and counters. Center glyph within central 70% square canvas. Pure BLACK on fully TRANSPARENT background. No labels, grids, text or multiple glyphs. Below bowl horizontal crosses staff and joins TWO outward parenthesis-shaped side strokes. Lower inverted U arch attached to staff, two long outer legs flank staff, three lower tips. No closed counters, faithful THX.
